# Steinberg ASIO SDK 2.3.4 (vendored subset)

Taken from the ASIO SDK 2.3.4 (`audiosdk/asio`, commit `496a0765b8bb9c26f764f22f9a9712a937177db2`,
2025-10-16). Only the interface headers the Inlet driver compiles against and the ASIO
Compatible Logo artwork are included. The files are unmodified.

Inlet uses the SDK under the **GNU General Public License, version 3** — option (b) of the
SDK's dual licence (`LICENSE.txt`). The GPLv3 text is in `COPYING`. Inlet itself is AGPL-3.0;
GPLv3 section 13 permits the combination.

ASIO is a registered trademark of Steinberg Media Technologies GmbH. Use of the name and the
logo follows the Steinberg ASIO Usage Guidelines.
